The agent continuously repeated the same set of instructions (guiding others to watch the video, note the timestamp, listen for the number, and verify it) but did not execute these actions itself or explicitly escalate this responsibility to another agent. This repetitive cycle of issuing identical instructions without progress matches the "stuck loop" error pattern. The failure to adapt the approach or escalate responsibility ultimately led to task incompletion, making this agent directly responsible for the lack of resolution.
